entities.name: Liana
entities.description: A young Simic apprentice biomancer who believes biomancy should improve lives.

entities.name: Florin Ozbolt
entities.description: An eccentric older master Simic biomancer who takes Liana as apprentice and transforms himself into ooze in Experiment One.

entities.name: Florin Ozbolt, ooze form
entities.description: The gelatinous remade version of Florin, who claims to have bettered himself and tries to lure Liana into the vat.

entities.name: Jovan
entities.description: Liana's friend, on whom she has a crush.

entities.name: Master Murat
entities.description: A Simic master who recommended Florin to Liana.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The biomancer guild of Ravnica that seeks to understand and protect natural life.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild of chemisters whose lab tech supplies injured rats and which tests devices on goblins.

entities.name: Fathom Edict
entities.description: The Simic guild's founding statement of purpose, as given by the prime speaker.

entities.name: Experiment One
entities.description: Florin's secret project using mimetic ooze, which ends with Florin remaking himself.

entities.name: Izzet chemister
entities.description: An unnamed Izzet chemister in Florin's story who died using her neural chronaccelerator.

entities.name: Neural chronaccelerator
entities.description: An Izzet device that accelerates thought and fried its inventor's brain.

entities.name: Subject 23
entities.description: A rat missing a front leg that regrows an ooze limb.

events.summary: Liana arrives at Master Ozbolt's lab and meets Florin, who asks her to call him by his first name; they discuss her philosophy and she becomes his apprentice.
events.quote: I think I'm exactly where I should be.

events.summary: Liana and Florin test a mimetic ooze limb-replacement therapy on rats, including Subject 23.
events.quote: Liana dipped a swab into the vial of ooze in front of her

events.summary: Florin tells Liana the story of an Izzet chemister who died using her neural chronaccelerator, and asks whether she did the right thing.
events.quote: A few hours later, she was dead.

events.summary: Florin warns that improving yourself may change you in disturbing ways.
events.quote: When you seek to improve the world around you, you start by improving yourself.

events.summary: Subject 23's ooze graft grows, and Florin declares them ready to begin.
events.quote: In that case," he said, "I'd say we're finally ready to begin.

events.summary: Liana returns to find the lab dark and Florin missing, and an ooze vat moves.
events.quote: Then the ooze in one of the vats... moved.

events.summary: Florin has remade himself as an ooze creature and says he has bettered himself.
Florin invites Liana to remake herself in the vat; she flees the lab.
events.quote: She turned and stumbled through the darkened lab

relations.quote: I'm to apprentice to Master Ozbolt.

relations.note: She is a Simic biomancer apprentice.
relations.quote: I'd say Simic, as a guild, operates out of a desire to understand and protect natural life
For a master Simic biomancer, aging naturally could be called eccentric

relations.note: He put Florin's name forward as her master.
relations.quote: Master Murat put your name forward.
